name: Braiin Limited
summary: Braiin Limited operates as a technology company. The company applies artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to generate actionable insights across agriculture technology, customer experience and employee experience as a service, and property technology. Its platforms are built on a single technology architecture for data ingestion, insight generation, and automation, which allows capability developed in one vertical to be deployed across the others. It serves enterprise, government, and carrier customers, as well as consumers in the telecommunications connection business.
